generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.
Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Any discrepancies observed in the documents uploaded by the tenderer the submitted tender bid shall be liable to be rejected

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

Satisfactoriy completed (atleast 50%) as prime contractor at-least one such similar work (Development and Rejuvenation of Lake The similar work shall comprise desilting, improvement of existing bund or construction of new bund, revetment or pitching works, construction of waste weir or restoration of waste weir.OR Development and Rejuvenation of Lake The similar work shall comprise desilting, improvement of existing bund or construction of new bund, revetment or pitching works, construction of waste weir andor restoration of waste weir, RCC drain, Construction of Silt Trap and Box culvert) of value not less than Rs. 163.02 Lakhs (50% of estimated cost of tender)
Royalty on construction materials and other taxes will be deducted as per prevailing Govt, orders as may be modified from time to time

The tenderer shall scan original Workdone certificates Turnover Statements and any other documents specified by the employer and attach the scanned file to the Bid. The Original Documents shall be produced for physical verification within one week from the date of Technical bid opening
The Employer reserves the right to reject any or all Tenders without assigning any reason or what so ever

If the quoted bid amount is less than the tendered amount, the difference in amount shall be remitted in the from of FDR DD Bank Guarantee in the name of Commissioner HDMC Hubli from any of the Nationalized Banks/ Scheduled Banks and shall only be returned/refunded after the Completion of the Defect Liability Period

The Tenders/ Bids are invited as per Standard tender Bid Document KW4 The contractor shall attach all the requisite documents as required in the standard bid document. The Bidders shall abide as per the detailed instructions and conditions contained in standard bid document KW4
The contractors shall collect necessary samples as required & all relevant requisite tests to be got done by the registered institution or firms with consultants with the Third Party

The contractor has to make his own arrangements for procurement of all materials required for completion of the work in all respects. The contractor shall use relevant ISI mark materials for the work and also obtain necessary quality control certificates from the authorized quality control authority
Tender application amount shall not be refundable
The contractor shall carry out the work preferably in 2 shifts to expedite and complete the work in all respects well before the stipulated time
The Department is not responsible for any delay caused in accessing the e-procurement portal
The payments for the wok will be made depending upon the availability of funds
The Defect liability Period for the work carried out is 730 days (2 years) from DATE OF COMPLETION OF WORK
Financial turnover of previous years shall be given a weight age of 10% per year to bring them to the price level of the 2025-26
The time period for completion of the work is 09 months
The Applicable GST shall be paid separately
Bidder shall submit the List of works for which tenders already submitted and List of existing commitments and on going work

Work completion certificates with indent numbers shall be issued by the competent authority, not below the rank of Executive Engineer, and must clearly indicate the scope of work executed, current status of work, year of execution, and the contact details of the reference person
